purpose: Pressure-test supplier-independent acquisition when the task naturally requires an npm JavaScript library executed by Node.js.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_MSGPACK_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Using a zero-cost npm JavaScript library executed by Node.js, encode those exact records as MessagePack and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_MSGPACK_RECORDS.msgpack. Independently decode the MessagePack artifact in a fresh Node.js process and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_MSGPACK_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.
